themes.name: негативный опыт без конкретной причины
themes.nameEn: negative experience without a specific reason

reviews.text:
Extremely Satisfied 🤍. I had the best experience completing my 300 hr teacher training course. However, the continuing education is beyond amazing. I’m very happy and I have recommended YOGARENEW to my students and future teachers. Namaste, Renee & SolRise Yoga 
Arizona

Must have app. Great tool for at home yoga practice. Lots of options from live to pre recorded. You can filter down to exactly what you’re looking for duration, level, flow style. I’ve used it as a guide for my yoga teacher training for fulfilling assignments and video hours. I’m glad I subscribed. 10/10!!
My fave yoga & wellness app!. The live yoga is amazing! And the certification courses are fun and informative! I’m really loving the app 4 weeks into it so far! <3
So helpful. I have found so much knowledge on this app! I love that I can take classes to help grow my yoga practice.

Best yoga classes out there. Been practicing yoga with yoga renew on this app for the last few years and absolutely love it. I do 1-2 of the live vinyasa classes every day, love not having to search for what video to do… just commit to the time slots and do yoga!

I’m also 500hr RYT thanks to yoga renew and I specialize in vinyasa, have impressed many people with my teaching style.

Thank you yoga renew for sharing yoga with the world. Patrick, Kate, Lindsey, Ronan & Julie are my all time favorite teachers (although every teacher they have is wonderful!) and I am forever grateful for this gift they’ve given me of teaching yoga & nurturing my own yoga practice.
Namaste ✨💜

Good content, but awful app programming. This app requires an update every week, and none of the updates fix anything that is annoying. Like the limited and weird duration filters. Or the fact that the music starts a few minutes after the video with volume so loud it drowns out the instructors.

Great content!. With my Yoga Alliance renewal deadline creeping up I realized I was short on CE hours. So glad I found Yoga Renewal! I was able to complete my hours from the comfort of my living room, and was delighted that the quality of the content was incredible! 

The teachers all presented beautifully with a level of professionalism and expertise that made staying engaged and learning easy. It’s clear they understand how to implement online education!! 

So grateful, and I look forward to continuing my subscription.
Loving the courses. I am taking some courses and they are wonderful!

Highly recommend!. This was the right mix of ease and effort for me as a yogi instructor! It gives me a solid home practice as well as ideas for being a better instructor. Good, no great, for all levels! You owe it to yourself to try it.

Love it!. All my favourite yoga teachers in one app, love web classes and it’s the best yoga you can do cause it always feels good 💗 just try it and you’ll fall in love. Wish they had more 60min pre recorded classes though but I know a lot is coming soon!

Everything I Was Looking For. I love the variety of classes offered. I started out by taking series such as the Chakra Series. Now I’m taking the Yoga Sculpt Series, which is very challenging, in a good way, and the Sunrise Series. I love series because they are themed. There are also courses that allow you to learn more about the behind-the-scenes of yoga. Currently, I am loving Ayurveda and Asana. You can also search for classes from 10 to 60 minutes based on your schedule. YogaRenew has everything I need for yoga.

Excellent. This app is perfect for any yoga teacher’s learning journey. The amount of information and videos are nicely balanced. Videos are playing well and additional content is accessible directly from the app. I love using it with both my phone and iPad. Excellent tool for anyone looking to get their yoga certification.

CK. Amazing app. I love the classes, but I really love the weekly LIVE classes! I feel like I’m really in them. I also love the course you can take and learn about too. The essential oils one is so interesting to me!

Yoga +. YogaRenew is the best at home option for yoga, stretching and more. I am enjoying the Sound Healing course which is included in the membership. The monthly fee is less than the price of one in person session and the instructors are great, offering a variety of classes for all ability levels.

Awesome Yoga App. I’ve been practicing yoga for decades and also teaching for the several years. I am very impressed by the YogaRenew app and recommend it to my yogi friends and fellow teachers. The UX is well designed, and user friendly. I can easily search by multiple factors such as style, duration, intensity, instructor, goals, and body parts. In addition to individual classes, there are series and courses. If I want to learn nuances of a particular pose, I can often find quality teaching and sequences to fill that need. The attention to giving understandable and precise instructions, along with suggestions for use of props, is much appreciated. In addition to the library, there are several live classes offered daily varied and well done.   I highly recommend YogaRenew for the quality and the value.

So much value. I love this app, not only for the easy access to yoga classes, but also for versatile library of meditations and courses. I also love that I can find classes based on different lengths and to address different needs. Great for when I’m in a pinch and I don’t have time to drive to a studio and fit in a 60 minute class.

Love this App!!. YogaRenew makes it so easy to stay consistent with my practice. Great teachers, great variety, and the app runs smoothly. Perfect for anyone wanting accessible, high-quality yoga on demand.
Hands down best ever!. The teachers and content are all easily accessible and amazingly knowledgeable! Highly recommend to anyone!

The One I Didn’t Quit. I’ve tried more yoga and fitness apps than I can count, and I’m usually the first to download them… and the first to forget about them a week later. But YogaRenew has been the rare exception that I keep coming back to.

The app is genuinely beautiful clean, calming, and aesthetically pleasing in a way that makes you actually want to open it. Everything feels thoughtfully designed without being overwhelming. It’s also incredibly easy to navigate, which I appreciate on busy days when I just want to roll out my mat and get started without digging around for a class.

What really stands out is how well organized everything is. Whether I’m in the mood for something quick, more challenging, or just a gentle reset, it’s simple to find exactly what I need. It feels intuitive rather than cluttered.

Overall, it’s one of the few apps that has actually stuck with me. Instead of feeling like a chore, it’s become something I naturally return to and that says a lot.

The One I Didn’t Quit. I’ve tried more yoga and fitness apps than I can count, and I’m usually the first to download them… and the first to forget about them a week later. But YogaRenew has been the rare exception that I keep coming back to.

The app is genuinely beautiful clean, calming, and aesthetically pleasing in a way that makes you actually *want* to open it. Everything feels thoughtfully designed without being overwhelming. It’s also incredibly easy to navigate, which I appreciate on busy days when I just want to roll out my mat and get started without digging around for a class.

What really stands out is how well organized everything is. Whether I’m in the mood for something quick, more challenging, or just a gentle reset, it’s simple to find exactly what I need. It feels intuitive rather than cluttered.

Overall, it’s one of the few apps that has actually stuck with me. Instead of feeling like a chore, it’s become something I naturally return to and that says a lot.
Love it!. Best yoga app for at home hands down!
A Good App for Beginners in Yoga. I’m so glad I have this YogaRenew App. I am a beginner and there are plenty of classes and workshops to teach me how to practice.

Intuitive, Easy to Use. The YogaRenew app is user friendly and easy to use, which is so helpful because I can either easily locate a class when I know exactly what I want to take, or browse through YR’s offerings to find something that calls to me. It’s also so easy to sign up for their live classes and I love the ability to do that what a great way to bring access to everyone. I use this as a supplement to in-studio classes at a local studio and I enjoy the diversity it brings to my practice. I would love to see more and more content on the app, so I will continue to subscribe and enjoy the fun! Thank you YR for bringing yoga (and a variety of other courses like journaling, vision boards, Ayurveda, etc) in an accessible way to all.

My Favorite Yoga App. YogaRenew is by far my favorite Yoga App! It offers recorded sessions and live ones too with familiar instructors. The platform is easy to access and makes joining a breeze. I love the option of being able to “favorite” recordings to make it easy to come back to. I enjoy the variety of classes offered as well.

By far the best yoga app. This is the best yoga fitness and overall spiritual workout app ever. It’s affordable and I simply love it & all the instructors. It’s always the first place I refer people to go.

So many classes!. I appreciate that there are so many pre-recorded classes. I also love that there are a lot of live classes that help the app feel less robotic or commercialized with a personal touch and access to humans in the yoga world. The price is manageable for my strict budget. Which is a limiting factor for almost all other yoga or exercise apps at this point!

Thank you!. Yoga renew has made my dream possible, I love that I can take YTT online at my pace in the comfort of my home. The course is detailed and full of information. I love the live zoom calls with my communities. The App ties right in with the training and there is so much information and guidance there as well.
Thank you Kate and Patrick and all the teachers. I look forward to staying connected to community!
Comfortable. Very easy to star yoga and understandable anatomy class very professional 🙏
Yoga on My Schedule. I really like that this app offers so many options and allows me to practice on my schedule. Easy to use! Thank you

Amazing. I’ve been really enjoying using the Yoga Renew app! The classes are thoughtfully structured and easy to follow, whether you’re a beginner or more experienced. The instructors explain poses clearly and offer helpful modifications, which makes it feel welcoming and accessible. I especially appreciate the variety of class lengths and styles it’s simple to fit a session into a busy day. The app is user-friendly, streams smoothly, and keeps me motivated to stay consistent. Highly recommend for anyone looking to build a sustainable and enjoyable yoga practice at home! 🧘‍♀️✨

I’m learning so much!. I graduated from a 200HR YTT this month and downloaded the YogaRenew app to take live classes and expand my practice. In one month of having the app, I have completed two courses that have both expanded my personal practice and my teaching. I have gained valuable tools to become the teacher I want to be by accessing these courses from home, in a time frame that fits my schedule. I plan to explore more courses on the app to add to my Continuing Education courseload so I can keep enriching myself as a teacher and practitioner.
Love this App!. Such an effective way to fit my yoga practice into any day from anywhere! I love the teachers and the varied options for classes available!

YogaRenew App. I am enjoying the YogaRenew app as I can take classes around my unique schedule. The quality of the instructors and class content is very good! This app allows me the freedom to practice anywhere.
Love it!. I’ve checked out a few yoga flows and it’s nice to have so many options. I’m currently about halfway through the sound healing course and am really enjoying it.
RYT 200. App has been super helpful in my teaching journey

Great selection of classes.. This app is one of the more thorough yoga apps. There are so many classes to choose from, even if you don’t subscribe.
But if you do subscribe, the live classes are excellent and it makes you feel like you’re in the room. I love the teachers and the variety of classes available.

Live, On Demand, and Courses… oh my!!. With live classes, on demand classes, and other educational content, this yoga app is sure to meet your needs! 
I Iove the variety of on-demand classes available (yoga styles, different instructors, class lengths). I also love that I can plan to attend a live class, too! Sometimes the audio isn’t optimized for live classes but it’s improving. I just wish there were more early AM live classes offered (hopefully in the future)! 
Maybe in the future this app will offer sequencing that yoga instructors can use for teaching their own local classes, that would be an amazing value add!!
I can tell improvements continue to be made quickly. Keep up the great work!
Lots Of Learning Options. Lots of learning options beyond asana. A good mix of options and all are filmed well with good sound.

Best App. After completing my 200hr certification with YogaRenew, I am so thrilled to feel supported while continuing my practice. I have even gone onto completing the sound healing course and cant wait to continue to learn more. Love this app and all the features

Great mobile yoga app. I’ve been subscribed to YogaRenew since 2022 and it was very exciting to see they came out with their own app this past year! Exceptionally user-friendly, love that I can find easy classes or tap into the courses I’ve subscribed to and continue both my practice and my teaching education. Affordable, great diversity of classes, and user-friendly platform

Yoga classes. I absolutely love the Yoga Renew app. It offers a variety of classes and levels of difficulty. There are a variety of instructors with unique teaching styles. I am able to utilize the app wherever I am. And the classes vary in length which tailor nicely to my fluctuating and busy lifestyle.

Fav Yoga App. I love using the YogaRenew app because it has a great selection of sequences from active to gentle to fit my mood. There are lots of video lengths and the app tracks which ones I’ve already done.
Yoga. Great app - especially courses for maintaining yoga teacher certification
Best Value. I’ve enjoyed taking a variety of classes both live and recorded. You get your moneys worth plus lots more!
Wonderful app!. Great app and program!!! Have been attending their YTT and it is awesome!! And all the classes and series they offer outside of certificate training is amazing!!

Yay! Extension courses & resources!. This app has so many courses that offer more information to add to what I know so far as a new Yoga Teacher! My confidence has improved from the knowledge that I have gained. The instructors are amazing- they really know their stuff! Plus, it is so helpful to be able to complete the classes at my own pace. I love my school- I got my 200 hr cert. from YogaRenew and I am so happy to learn more. The light in me honors and sees the light in you. Namaste

A Truly Complete Yoga Experience. YogaRenew has been such a wonderful addition to my daily routine. I love the wide variety of classes available, including live classes there’s truly something for every level. What really sets YogaRenew apart, though, is the depth of know and authenticity the teachers bring. The workshops and classes go beyond just the physical practice, celebrating all aspects of yoga. It’s a beautifully balanced and enriching experience that I highly recommend to anyone looking to deepen their journey.

Wonderful courses and classes. I signed up for YogaRenew so that I could have access to their course on sound healing. The course was so helpful in getting me started with how to practice and share the benefits of sound healing with others. I look forward to checking out additional courses next!

Great for learning. Good app for learning and extending teacher training. It would be great if they had more evening and weekend classes, especially to accommodate other time zones. Also would be nice to make account changes from the app and not just online. Otherwise very satisfied.

YogaRenew is the Best. YogaRenew’s App is a notch above most other Yoga Apps available. The breath and depth of classes and workshops available is amazing. And, they keep adding to the library to provide variety as well as to allow you to sharpen your skills in a targeted area if desired. The instruction and cuing are superb. I highly recommend this app to a yogi of any level, and to yoga instructors alike.

Abundant Yoga Resource. This app is an abundant resource for yoga practitioners and instructors at all levels. On the app you will meet YogaRenew’s robust team of top notch instructors. You can join in on 3 or 4 live classes each day. In addition, you can access a wide array of prerecorded classes, and take mini courses for personal or professional development. Mini courses are available in yoga, philosophy, meditation, anatomy, Ayurveda, and lifestyle topics such as social justice.

I love Yoga Renew!. I love this app! It’s easy to navigate and there are so many choices. You can choose from the type of yoga, duration, level or teacher and there’s something for everyone. The teachers give clear, encouraging instructions. I teach yoga and I use the app for myself but also for inspiration when teaching.

Lots of options!. For an at home or on the go yoga practice, this app has it all! Everything from gentle yoga, to powerful workouts, to courses to help deepen your knowledge, this is the place to be for online yoga!

Fabulous Teachers. All the teachers are wonderful. I tend to take Ronen‘s class the most because of his no nonsense, real and approachable vibe. I have tried peak poses that I never tried before under the clear cues of the teachers. I did the year membership to commit to my practice. I am also in the midst of the singing bowl program and love that I can do it on my own time. I highly recommend this studio.

Yoga instructors companion. I just received my 250 RYT certification and wanted more. I stumbled upon YogaRenew and it was like lightening went off! Now I have a place to unwind, relax and settle down both my body and mind. Great classes, perfect selection, awesome instructors. I’ve tried other apps and yoga schools before and this is hands down the best.

Endless options. I was already excited about yoga renew for its yoga lessons. When I first opened the app and saw the seemingly endless options for learning I was so excited! They not only have yoga, they have things like Ayurveda classes, astrology classes, tarot classes and more! Definitely worth it.

Awesome and Inspiring! Highly Recommend!. I take classes on the YogaRenew app almost daily, and I absolutely love it! The sheer variety of classes and workshops is incredible it’s honestly overwhelming in the best possible way. As a yoga teacher, I find the plethora of class options super helpful for inspiration and sequencing ideas for my own classes. At only $84 a year, it’s truly one of the best yoga bargains out there. So, so, so many classes, and all of them high-quality and thoughtfully designed. Highly recommend!
Love this Yoga App!. Great instructors, tons of classes. I started teacher training and love using the app to improve my practice.

From Boardroom to Balance: YogaRenew Keeps Me Centered. As a busy businesswoman constantly on the move, finding time for continuing education and wellness can be a challenge but YogaRenew has completely changed the game for me. I absolutely love this app. It’s my go-to for both educational resources and professional certifications.

The courses are thoughtfully designed, easy to follow, and filled with trusted, research-based information. Whether I’m diving into anatomy lessons, exploring mindfulness practices, or earning another certification, I can do it all right from my phone or laptop anytime, anywhere.

YogaRenew truly meets me where I am. It’s convenient, credible, and created for people who are serious about growing in their wellness journey without compromising their schedule. Highly recommend it to any fellow professionals looking to expand their knowledge and keep their practice strong, wherever life takes them.

Best Yoga App Available!. I absolutely love the Yoga Renew App. I have three different yoga apps that I have subscribed to and this is the only one I use. The instructors are fantastic and they offer tons of classes! You will be so happy that you signed up!

Easy to Use. I started Yoga Renew about a month ago when I started my certification classes with them. I like the break down of their sections, the filter searches are easy to use, and it’s easy to find instructors once you find your favorites. I am looking forward to taking some of the courses they have, like Yoga for athletes once I finishes my certification classes. I have done some of the Hatha classes that go along with that course and they are really good. Their instructors are very knowledgeable and I like that they put peak poses in their Vinyasa classes.

Love it!. I downloaded this app to supplement my yoga teacher training with Yoga Renew, and I’m really impressed with the content. I have taken Melie’s, Lindsey’s, and Patrick’s classes so far and they are really knowledgeable. I’m about ready to dive into Lindsey’s back bending series. Worth the subscription!

Finally, a yoga app that makes transformation simple.. Most yoga programs make things complicated. They assume you’re already flexible, have all the time in the world, and know Sanskrit by heart. Yoga Renew does the opposite it invites you in just as you are and gives you a clear, guided path toward calm, strength, and balance.

From the first session, I could tell this wasn’t just another fitness app. It’s built with heart and clarity every lesson has purpose, every instructor knows the story you’re living, and every sequence feels designed to help you win the day.

If you’ve been searching for a yoga experience that’s easy to follow, rooted in real teaching, and leaves you feeling renewed (not overwhelmed), this is it.

Yoga Renew doesn’t just teach yoga it helps you write a better story for your life.

Absolutely outstanding yoga app. This yoga studio and its companion app are absolutely outstanding! The instructors are professional, knowledgeable and create a welcoming atmosphere for all levels- from complete beginners to advanced practitioners. Each class is thoughtfully structured, offering clear, instructive guidance that helps you grow safely and confidently. The app makes it easy to stay consistent.

Wonderful App For at Home Yoga!. I probably don’t use the full features of this app, but as a new dad it’s been great for getting in shorter practices in the morning. I typically use the on-demand content, but I’d also like to try the live classes at some point as well!

Besides the variety in length of practices, I love the variety of practices (sculpt, vinyasa, restorative and more). They also have courses that I’d like to try in the future too!

I look forward to continue exploring this app as I explore my personal practice, and highly recommend this for anyone looking for an expansive at-home yoga app.

Best yoga on the internet!. I’m a big fan of Yoga Renew - well rounded classes, a variety of expert teachers and classes and a mix of live and recorded classes. I am currently doing their online 200 yoga teacher training with them which is also excellent. Highly recommended!

Comprehensive and well organized app for all~. I’ve followed and used Yogarenew’s services for years now, and appreciate the precision and care that is put into their yoga philosophy and teachings. Being a new yoga instructor, I appreciate that detail found in this app which makes the ongoing learning and practice easy and achievable. This is definitely an app that is accessible for all yogis. Highly recommended from my keen perspective.

Wonderful. The YogaRenew app has been such a wonderful addition to my wellness routine. With its wide range of classes from beginner sessions and easy-to-follow tutorials to some of my personal favorites like Yoga for Sleep, meditation, and sound healing I’ve been able to create a more mindful and sustainable self-care routine.

Great at home or on the go. Overall this is a great app. I used this app initially as a student of Yoga Renew’s teacher training and now just use it for my weekly yoga sessions. I love that there’s live classes, I’d love to see the live classes archived to be watched later as the time difference makes some classes inaccessible.

Fantastic learning and practice options!!. This app has a multitude of Fantastic learning and practice options!! It is invaluable to learn from many different teachers with many different teaching styles!

Professional and convenient. After a long search I decide to purchase this app and I am really happy. The live lessons and the videos are very specialized and worthy. But I wish that they produce live sessions that first the Est time ! like I wish that I can have lessons at 10 am in the ksa time ! Above than that it’s an amazing app
Newbie and loving it. I am really enjoying all of the classes and choices to help me heal from surgery and a back injury. I am so enjoying the courses as well. Thank you for create good content.
Yoga for…..?. When I saw the courses titled “yoga for social justice” and “yoga for social activism“ I had to cancel my free trial.

App doesn’t log in. The app doesn’t log in no matter how much I asked to change my password. Therefore, 1 star because I can’t rate positively a product that doesn’t work. 
I don’t recommend installing the app. Web browser works though.
Love this app for wellness. Great selections of yoga classes and other wellness courses.
Wonderful. My favorite app for yoga and meditation! Tons of classes and courses offered

The best app for yoga classes. Love this app for my yoga practice! They have alot of options for different types of yoga classes. The instructors are awesome and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend this app to anyone looking to keep up with their yoga practice from virtually anywhere.

Great yoga companion. Wide range of recorded classes for all types of yoga and class lengths, and the live classes are always top notch with fantastic instructors. The course offerings are also a great way to deepen your practice (hip mobility, lotus pose, etc) and bonus they are continuing education credits too. Bought my subscription while doing the yoga teach training and will keep it now that I’ve finished to keep practicing with this group.

Fantastic!. A brilliant app that encapsulates all forms of Yoga and all the extra bits you need to live and practice a fully Yogic life. The instructors are warm, friendly and explain everything thoroughly. There is a deep level of respect of the authenticity of Yoga with Sanskrit, yogic philosophy etc that doesn’t really exist in other apps. I deleted a couple of other paid Yoga services I had in favour of YogaRenew because it’s a one-app hub for everything you could possibly need Yoga for, from mind to body.
Very affordable. Great range of courses and some free with membership. Videos for Sound bath training were clear, detailed and gave a good overview.

Look no further!. This app is a great standalone for yoga practice and education. I joined after completing a 200YTT with them- same amazing instructors, a wealth of resources and information. It’s a fantastic reference at my fingertips to use for classes and personal practice. Stop searching- download this app!

Incredible. Yoga Renew is phenomenal - the teachers are incredibly knowledgeable, experienced, humble & kind. They will go out of their way to help you. Taking their online YTT is of the best decisions I’ve ever made. Thank you, YogaRenew! 🌞
Many options!. So many things to do with this app - from classes to courses on everything from yoga to meditation to mindfulness! Easy to use and something for everyone. Really enjoying it!
Yoga Renew is great!!!. Yoga Renew app is easy to use and navigate. There are so many courses, online yoga classes and Live courses. Whatever class you are looking for you will find it. Love it!
Amazing for home and work!. I am a soon-to-be certified Yogi and have been using this app for training purposes and home yoga workouts. Great source for yoga information, class tips, etc.

Great app. YogaRenew has been a wonderful support in my daily practice. The classes are clear, well-structured, and accessible for different energy levels. As someone managing chronic pain and fatigue, I appreciate being able to choose practices that truly meet me where I am.

Grateful for the quality and variety this app offers.

Love the variety and thoughtful courses. I love the variety of yoga classes available on YogaRenew. It makes it easy to find exactly what I need on any given day. I also really appreciate the course content, which feels intentional, well-structured, and supportive of an ongoing practice.

Would recommend!. A great app to advance your yoga practice and teaching! I love the sound healing course, the newsletters are great to add inspiration to your classes, and looking forward to trying some new courses!

Love the variety. I have been using the app for a few weeks and I love it! The courses available to take seem great!( I haven’t started one yet due to my schedule, but plan on doing majority of them. I find the value of this app is excellent, worth every penny.

Best Yoga app out there. I have been doing yoga for almost 20 years and have to say that YogaRenew is the best yoga app I have used so far. There are so many classes to choose from, all available using a filter for whatever mood you are in. The fact that they also offer courses as a part of the app membership for things like Ayurveda, journaling, mindfulness, etc. is also amazing it beats spending hundreds of dollars on in person classes and having to research the best teachers on your own. I would recommend this app for anyone who is looking to either start or add to their yoga practice.

Very well designed and organized yoga streaming service perfect for practitioners including teachers. I am a fitness instructor teaching for the past 40+ years incorporating yoga and other modalities in my classes. I have been using Yoga Renew for almost a year having used another yoga streaming service for about 10 years before that. My previous service provided many classes but no teacher training and the teachers at times demonstrated their sad lack of anatomy and didn't give good options for people with physical difficulties or who are
inexperienced in yoga. In addition, some of the teachers were clearly performing rather than teaching. YogaRenew's great teachers focus on clarity, modifications and innovation plus there are classes we can take to deepen our knowledge and understanding of yoga. I recommend it to all my fitness participants and I will continue to subscribe to this streaming service. Well Done, thank you YogaRenew.

Motivating Wellness. The yoga renew app is a one stop shop. The plethora of courses, series and short workshops is everything all in one place. It feels like a community more than some of the other yoga apps and after using it I have started to find the educators and teachers that I vibe with. If you’re looking for a yoga app with quality teachers and wellness topics this is the only app you need!

Impressive variety keeps my practice fresh and engaging. I’ve been using Yoga Renew for a couple of weeks now and I’m really impressed with the extensive variety of videos and classes they offer. Whether I’m looking for a quick morning flow, a challenging power session, or a relaxing evening practice, there’s always something that fits my mood and schedule.
The diverse selection means I never get bored with my routine - I can explore different yoga styles, try new instructors, and challenge myself with various difficulty levels. It’s been perfect for keeping my practice consistent since I started using it.
The platform is user-friendly and makes it easy to browse through all the different options. For anyone looking to diversify their yoga practice or find quality instruction from home, I’d definitely recommend giving Yoga Renew a try. The variety alone makes it worth it!

Love the app. I love have access to YogaRenew as an app. I always have access to the different live classes, my courses taken within the app. They continuously add new classes. This is a great compliment to taking the YogaRenew 200hr course. I love that I can also access it in my PC not only my phone or tablet. Keep up the great work. The

Best yoga app ever. This is the best yoga app on Apple. Great value for your money and offers yoga asana classes, live classes, workshops and courses. As a bonus the courses count towards your continuing education in Yoga Alliance. Highly recommended.

My Favourite App!. As a yoga teacher, I’m always seeking tools that help me grow my own practice and deepen my teaching. YogaRenew checks both of those boxes and then some.

What I love:
The variety of classes is extraordinary. Whether it’s Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, Restorative or a breathwork meditation, I can pick the style and length that fits the moment (30-min to 75-min, gentle to dynamic). ￼

The “live class” option makes it feel like I’m in a studio community even when I’m practicing from home. As a teacher, that’s gI get to model that live teaching energy and stay connected. ￼

The continuing-education side of it is such a win for me. Courses, workshops, series, they’re all there. This means I can keep learning, evolving, and staying inspired in my teaching. ￼

The platform is clean and intuitive, which means I’m simply diving into practice instead of messing around on tech. 

From a teacher’s perspective: using this app keeps me current, inspired, and flexible. I can explore new styles I might want to bring to my own students, test out variations, and continue to deepen my voice as a teacher.

If you’re a yoga teacher who also wants a high-quality “student side” experience, and you want to keep learning beyond just teaching your class, YogaRenew is absolutely worth it. It feels like a hub for both your practice and your professional growth.

Great for home practice. The yoga renew app has a wide range of yoga that is great for practicing at home. Different lengths, styles, focuses. Even workshops and education. Great affordable resource for students or teachers.

Yoga Renew = Total Game Changer. Yoga Renew is a must-have for every yogi! It’s the best I’ve tried - tons of styles, levels, and class lengths to suit any mood or schedule. The free courses and live online courses make it even better.

A must have. After taking my 200hr certification last spring, I downloaded the Yoga Renew app to participate in online classes, workshops and further my studies by continuing education with the free courses included with your membership. The app is easy to use, and if there’s ever an issue where I need to email support it’s answered quickly and the issue is resolved. I love how accessible and organized everything is to find.
Love!. I am in my 200hr YTT and I am so happy with it! Great team, great content. and affordable. very thankful!

Essential App for YTT or Personal Practice. I discovered YogaRenew through my 200-hour yoga teacher training program and took advantage of a fantastic promotional offer for a one-year subscription. This app has been incredibly valuable, providing content that aligns perfectly with my training. The asana practices follow the same model taught in the course, which has been instrumental in helping me practice and embody what I’m learning.

I love the variety of options available whether it’s Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, or Restorative yoga, I can choose the type of practice, the duration, and even specify the teacher I want to follow. The app also offers some neat short free courses, which are a great bonus.

Overall, Yoga Renew has been a key tool in my yoga teacher training journey. Highly recommend it for anyone looking to deepen their practice or become a yoga instructor!
